title: Pongalo Pongal
desc: Four unemployed graduates are loathed by their parents for their inability to support their families. However, destiny shines upon them after they join hands with a friend and become milk suppliers.

title: Aanai
desc: A former policeman is hired as a bodyguard for a girl child after a series of kidnappings in the city. However, he is in for a rude shock when the girl gets kidnapped and killed.

title: Mr. Bharath
desc: A businessman abandons his first love, to marry a rich heiress. However, things take a turn when his illegitimate son seeks revenge for the injustice done to his mother.

title: Ambasamuthiram Ambani
desc: Dhandapani dreams of becoming rich like Ambani, the industrialist, and invests in a shop constructed by Annachi. However, trouble ensues when Annachi dies before giving him possession of the property.

title: Suryavamsam
desc: Sakthivel, an influential man, is upset with his son Chinnarasu's careless attitude. He is further infuriated when Chinnarasu suddenly refuses to marry his cousin, Gowri.
